source.title: Feralas Mission XIII: Defeat Tyrannikus
source.description: While these demons distract us here, the Emerald Dream is being corrupted into nightmare. Quick, travel through the Emerald Dream Portal in Dream Bough, and journey to the Nightmare Incursion in Oneiros. Defeat the dragon Tyrannikus there and return to me.
source.objective: Defeat Tyrannikus in the Feralas Nightmare Incursion at the ruined temple in Oneiros and return to Field Captain Arunnel.
source.completion: Well done! Your services shall be well rewarded. Perhaps another mission?
